description: Canonical parameter dictionary for digital-to-analog converters, merging five architectural sub-shapes that share one measurement envelope into a single family: (1) 'string' resistor-string DACs (guaranteed-monotonic, DC-accuracy oriented, moderate speed - the linearity/accuracy and settling keys dominate); (2) 'r2r' R-2R ladder DACs (voltage- or current-output, the reference_input_resistance/ladder and gain keys apply); (3) 'multiplying' MDACs whose reference is an AC input (multiplying_bandwidth, reference_feedthrough, feedback_resistance/RFB and a four-quadrant output, swept over the reference frequency F_IN); (4) 'current_steering' RF / high-speed DACs (full_scale_output_current into a compliance voltage, sample_rate/update rate from hundreds of MSPS to GSPS, the AC-performance family SFDR/IMD3/ACLR/NSD/phase_noise swept over output frequency F_OUT, JESD204B serdes lane rates); and (5) 'audio' DACs (dynamic_range A-weighted vs unweighted via the WEIGHTING axis, THD+N vs output level A_OUT, de-emphasis, and the digital interpolation-filter passband/stopband/group_delay keys). component.sub_type selects the architecture; a part populates only the groups its architecture uses (string/r2r -> linearity + settling; multiplying -> multiplying_bandwidth/reference_feedthrough/feedback_resistance over F_IN; current_steering -> full_scale_output_current + AC-performance over F_OUT + serdes; audio -> filter + dynamic_range + THD+N), while resolution, monotonicity, the linearity/accuracy keys, the analog_output, reference, timing, power and general keys are common. Voltage-output vs current-output is a topology fork carried by WHICH key is populated - output_voltage / output_voltage_range (V) on a voltage-output part vs full_scale_output_current (A) on a current-output part - NOT by any structural difference. Resolution and monotonicity use the 'bits' unit; INL/DNL normalize to ppm (altUnits % or V), offset to V, gain error to %, and the printed LSB figure is preserved in conditionsVerbatim - LSB is NOT a legal unit. glitch_impulse and digital_feedthrough carry the printed nV-s / pV-s figure in the 'Vs' unit (a printed 1 nV-s is 1e-9 Vs); the distinct glitch_magnitude and power_on_glitch are amplitudes in V. Every dBc / dBFS / dBm-per-Hz ratio rides its reference in conditionsVerbatim and the note-only REFERENCE condition and MUST NOT be merged across references (SFDR / noise_spectral_density / third_order_imd / adjacent_channel_leakage_ratio). power_supply_sensitivity printed as %/% normalizes to ppm/V (there is no %/% unit). SerDes / lane / input data rates store the bit rate in Hz with the printed Gbps/Mbps kept in conditionsVerbatim (there is no bps unit); latency stores seconds with the cycle count / fS in conditionsVerbatim. Condition axes for this family: STEP (settling step size, note-only), ACCURACY (settling accuracy, e.g. 1 LSB / 0.01%, note-only), CODE (input code, note-only), F_OUT (output signal frequency), A_OUT (output level in dBFS or Vrms), F_IN (reference AC frequency for multiplying DACs), F_S (sample/update rate as a condition), F_CLK (clock frequency as a condition), V_REF (reference voltage), GAIN (multiplying/PGA gain), INTERP (interpolation ratio, note-only), WEIGHTING (A-weighted vs unweighted, note-only), MODE (speed/power/filter mode, note-only), REFERENCE (the dB reference convention dBc / dBFS / dBm-per-Hz, note-only), BW_POINT (-3dB / -0.1dB, note-only), R_L (load resistance), C_L (load capacitance), T_A, PACKAGE, DIRECTION (source/sink, note-only). Pin functions: VOUT / VOUTA.. voltage outputs; IOUT1 / IOUT2 / IOUTP / IOUTN complementary current outputs; RFB the MDAC feedback resistor; VREF / VREFIO / REFIN / REFOUT reference; FSADJ / BIASJ full-scale-set; VDD / AVDD / DVDD / CLKVDD supplies and GND / AGND / DGND grounds; SPI control SCLK / SDIN / SYNC / SDO / CS / LDAC / CLR; I2C control SCL / SDA / A0; high-speed DACCLKP / DACCLKN / SYSREF / SYNC plus the JESD204B serdes lanes; audio serial BCK / LRCK / MCLK / DIN. Base-SI throughout; aliases normalize the printed datasheet symbols across vendors (TI, Analog Devices, Maxim, Cirrus Logic, AKM, ESS, Microchip).

parameters.name: Resolution
parameters.hint: Number of input bits (nominal word length). Bits; fractional not applicable here.

parameters.name: Monotonicity
parameters.hint: Resolution over which the output is guaranteed monotonic (never decreases for an increasing code). Bits. String and calibrated R-2R DACs are typically monotonic to the full resolution; capture the guaranteed-monotonic bit count.

parameters.name: Integral nonlinearity
parameters.hint: Deviation of the transfer function from the ideal line, normalized to ppm of full-scale (altUnits % or V). NEVER use LSB - keep the printed LSB figure in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Differential nonlinearity
parameters.hint: Deviation of each code step from the ideal 1-LSB size, normalized to ppm of full-scale (altUnits % or V). A DNL better than -1 LSB guarantees monotonicity. NEVER use LSB - keep the printed LSB value in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Offset error
parameters.hint: Bipolar / mid-scale offset error. Canonical V; altUnits ppm or % of full-scale. On a straight unipolar DAC the zero-point error is zero_code_error; this key carries the bipolar/offset-binary offset.

parameters.name: Gain error
parameters.hint: Full-scale / gain error, canonical % of full-scale (altUnits ppm; V on voltage-output DACs that print gain error in mV - keep the printed form in conditionsVerbatim). NEVER use LSB. full_scale_error is the same quantity on parts that print it separately from a mid/quarter-scale gain error.

parameters.name: Gain drift
parameters.hint: Temperature coefficient of gain, ppm/degC of full-scale.

parameters.name: Total unadjusted error
parameters.hint: Combined worst-case error (offset + gain + linearity) without calibration, % of full-scale.

parameters.name: Offset error drift
parameters.hint: Temperature coefficient of offset error. Canonical V/degC; altUnits ppm/degC of full-scale.

parameters.name: Zero-code error
parameters.hint: Output error when the input code is all-zeros (the analog output that should ideally be 0 V or the negative rail), in V (altUnits ppm or % of full-scale); keep any printed LSB figure in conditionsVerbatim. Distinct from offset_error, which is the bipolar/mid-scale offset.

parameters.name: Zero-code error drift
parameters.hint: Temperature coefficient of zero-code error, V/degC (altUnits ppm/degC of full-scale).

parameters.name: Full-scale error
parameters.hint: Error at the all-ones (full-scale) code, % of full-scale (altUnits ppm or V). Closely related to gain_error - use this key only when the datasheet tabulates a distinct full-scale figure; keep any printed LSB value in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Gain / full-scale mismatch (interchannel)
parameters.hint: Channel-to-channel full-scale / gain matching on a multi-channel DAC, % of full-scale. Distinct from interchannel_gain_mismatch (a dB audio/RF figure).

parameters.name: Output settling time
parameters.hint: Time for the output to settle to a stated accuracy band after a code change, s. Meaningless without both the step size and the settle band - array over STEP (full-scale, half-scale, 1-LSB step), and carry ACCURACY (e.g. 1 LSB, 0.01%, 0.1%) as a second condition. One measurement per (STEP, ACCURACY) point.

parameters.name: Output slew rate
parameters.hint: Maximum rate of change of the output during a large code transition, V/us.

parameters.name: Glitch impulse (energy)
parameters.hint: Net area of the code-transition glitch (the classic mid-scale major-carry glitch), in volt-seconds. A printed nV-s converts as 1 nV-s = 1e-9 Vs; keep the printed nV-s figure in conditionsVerbatim. Distinct from glitch_magnitude (the peak amplitude).

parameters.name: Glitch magnitude
parameters.hint: Peak amplitude of the code-transition glitch, V (as opposed to its area glitch_impulse).

parameters.name: Digital feedthrough
parameters.hint: Output disturbance coupled from the digital inputs while the DAC is not being updated (LDAC held), in volt-seconds. A printed nV-s is 1e-9 Vs; keep the printed figure in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Power-on glitch
parameters.hint: Peak output excursion during power-up before the interface is initialized, V.

parameters.name: DAC-to-DAC crosstalk
parameters.hint: Output change on one DAC channel caused by a full-scale code change on another channel, in V (altUnits dB where the datasheet gives an AC figure). channel_isolation / interchannel_isolation carry the frequency-swept AC isolation.

parameters.name: Reference crosstalk
parameters.hint: Coupling from a reference (or other input) modulation into the output, dB. Array over the reference/disturbance frequency F_IN; keep the reference level in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Channel isolation
parameters.hint: AC isolation of one output from an aggressor on another, dB. interchannel_isolation carries the frequency-swept stereo-separation figure on audio parts.

parameters.name: Interchannel isolation (channel separation)
parameters.hint: Stereo / interchannel separation, dB, swept over signal frequency F_IN (audio and multi-channel parts).

parameters.name: Third-order intermodulation distortion
parameters.hint: Two-tone third-order intermodulation, dB, swept over output frequency F_OUT. Store the printed signed value; the reference (dBc vs dBFS) rides in conditionsVerbatim and the note-only REFERENCE condition and MUST NOT be merged across references. Keep the two tone frequencies and levels in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Adjacent-channel leakage ratio
parameters.hint: Leakage of a modulated carrier into the adjacent channel (current_steering / RF DACs), dBc, swept over output/carrier frequency F_OUT. Store the printed signed value; the reference (dBc) rides in conditionsVerbatim and the note-only REFERENCE condition; keep the standard/bandwidth in conditionsVerbatim. Do NOT merge across references.

parameters.name: Phase noise
parameters.hint: Single-sideband phase noise of the reconstructed output (current_steering / RF DACs), in dBc/Hz at a stated offset frequency F from the carrier. Array over the offset frequency F; keep the carrier frequency and dBc/Hz reference in conditionsVerbatim and the note-only REFERENCE condition.

parameters.name: Signal-to-noise ratio
parameters.hint: SNR of the reconstructed output (noise only, harmonics excluded), dB, swept over output frequency F_OUT. Store the printed signed value; the reference (dBFS vs dBc) rides in conditionsVerbatim and the note-only REFERENCE condition. Do NOT compare a dBc figure against a dBFS figure.

parameters.name: Signal-to-noise-and-distortion
parameters.hint: SINAD of the reconstructed output (noise + harmonics), dB, swept over output frequency F_OUT. Reference in conditionsVerbatim and the note-only REFERENCE condition.

parameters.name: Total harmonic distortion
parameters.hint: THD of the reconstructed output, canonical dB (altUnits % for audio parts), swept over output frequency F_OUT. Store the printed signed value; the reference (dBFS vs dBc) rides in conditionsVerbatim and the note-only REFERENCE condition. Do NOT compare a dBc figure against a dBFS figure.

parameters.name: THD+N
parameters.hint: THD+N (audio), canonical dB (altUnits %), swept over output level A_OUT (dBFS / Vrms). Reference in conditionsVerbatim and the note-only REFERENCE condition.

parameters.name: Spurious-free dynamic range
parameters.hint: SFDR - output full-scale to the largest spur, dB, swept over output frequency F_OUT. Store the printed signed value; the reference (dBc vs dBFS) rides in conditionsVerbatim and the note-only REFERENCE condition. A dBc suppression is a positive magnitude; a dBFS spur level is negative. Do NOT merge across references.

parameters.name: Second-harmonic distortion
parameters.hint: Second harmonic of the reconstructed output, dB, swept over output frequency F_OUT. Store the printed signed value; the reference (dBc vs dBFS) rides in conditionsVerbatim and the note-only REFERENCE condition. Do NOT compare a dBc figure against a dBFS figure.

parameters.name: Third-harmonic distortion
parameters.hint: Third harmonic of the reconstructed output, dB, swept over output frequency F_OUT. Store the printed signed value; the reference (dBc vs dBFS) rides in conditionsVerbatim and the note-only REFERENCE condition. Do NOT compare a dBc figure against a dBFS figure.

parameters.name: Noise spectral density
parameters.hint: Output noise density (current_steering / RF DACs), typically in dBm/Hz (or dBc/Hz), unit dB, swept over output frequency F_OUT. Store the printed signed value; the reference (dBm/Hz vs dBc/Hz vs dBFS/Hz) rides in conditionsVerbatim and the note-only REFERENCE condition and MUST NOT be merged across references.

parameters.name: Dynamic range
parameters.hint: Ratio of full-scale output to the residual noise floor with no signal (audio). Array over WEIGHTING (A-weighted vs unweighted) - do not merge the two. dB, dBFS reference in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: De-emphasis error
parameters.hint: Deviation of the de-emphasis filter response from the ideal curve (audio), dB; keep the sample rate / curve (32/44.1/48 kHz) in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Passband
parameters.hint: Interpolation / reconstruction filter passband edge, Hz (audio / current_steering). Array over INTERP (interpolation ratio / filter mode). Often stated as a fraction of fS - keep that in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Passband ripple
parameters.hint: Peak-to-peak interpolation-filter passband ripple, dB.

parameters.name: Stopband
parameters.hint: Interpolation / reconstruction filter stopband edge, Hz. Array over INTERP.

parameters.name: Stopband attenuation
parameters.hint: Interpolation-filter stopband attenuation (image rejection), dB.

parameters.name: Group delay
parameters.hint: Interpolation-filter group delay, s. Array over INTERP. Often stated in samples - convert via fS and keep the sample count in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Interchannel gain mismatch
parameters.hint: Gain match between channels expressed in dB (audio / RF). The %-of-full-scale interchannel match is gain_mismatch.

parameters.name: Interchannel phase deviation
parameters.hint: Phase match between channels, in degrees.

parameters.name: Full-scale output voltage
parameters.hint: Voltage-output DACs: the full-scale output voltage, V. Populating this key (vs full_scale_output_current) is what marks a part as voltage-output; a current-output part leaves it empty.

parameters.name: Output voltage range (swing)
parameters.hint: Voltage-output DACs: the guaranteed output voltage swing (min/max), V - how close the output drives to each rail. output_headroom / output_footroom capture the rail margins.

parameters.name: Output current drive
parameters.hint: Voltage-output DACs: the load current the output buffer can source/sink while holding spec, A. Distinct from full_scale_output_current (the programmed full-scale current of a current-output DAC).

parameters.name: Full-scale output current
parameters.hint: Current-output DACs: the full-scale output current (set by FSADJ / an external RSET), A. Populating this key (vs output_voltage) marks a part as current-output.

parameters.name: Output compliance voltage
parameters.hint: Current-output DACs: the allowable output-terminal voltage range over which the current output stays in spec, V.

parameters.name: Output resistance / impedance
parameters.hint: Output resistance (voltage-output buffer) or output impedance (current-output source), ohm. No SI prefix - 10 kohm is 10000.

parameters.name: Output capacitance
parameters.hint: Output-node capacitance, F. Code-dependent on current-output / ladder DACs (the switched ladder capacitance) - array over CODE, one measurement per stated code.

parameters.name: Output bandwidth
parameters.hint: Small-signal -3 dB bandwidth of the output, Hz.

parameters.name: Output short-circuit current
parameters.hint: Output short-circuit / current-limit, A.

parameters.name: Load regulation
parameters.hint: Change in output voltage per unit load current, expressed as an effective ohm; keep any printed mV/mA or %/mA figure in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Capacitive load stability
parameters.hint: Maximum capacitive load the output stays stable (non-oscillating) into, F. Array over series/parallel load resistance R_L.

parameters.name: Output headroom (to positive rail)
parameters.hint: Voltage-output DACs: minimum drop from the positive supply the output can reach at a stated load, V.

parameters.name: Output footroom (to negative rail / ground)
parameters.hint: Voltage-output DACs: minimum voltage above ground / the negative rail the output can reach at a stated load, V.

parameters.name: Output leakage current
parameters.hint: Output leakage current in the off / three-state condition, A. Array over ambient temperature T_A (rises with temperature).

parameters.name: Output noise (peak-to-peak)
parameters.hint: Broadband output noise over a stated band, statistic peak_to_peak (carry statistic on the measurement); keep the measurement bandwidth in conditionsVerbatim. V.

parameters.name: Output noise spectral density
parameters.hint: Output-referred voltage noise spectral density, V/sqrtHz, at a stated frequency (kept in conditionsVerbatim).

parameters.name: External reference voltage range
parameters.hint: Allowable external reference voltage range, V. Distinct from internal_reference_voltage.

parameters.name: Internal reference voltage
parameters.hint: On-chip reference output voltage, V.

parameters.name: Internal reference drift
parameters.hint: Temperature coefficient of the internal reference, ppm/degC.

parameters.name: Internal reference accuracy
parameters.hint: Initial accuracy of the internal reference, % of nominal.

parameters.name: Reference input current
parameters.hint: Current drawn from an external reference, A. On a multiplying DAC this scales with the ladder resistance and code; keep the code/reference in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Reference input range (multiplying)
parameters.hint: Multiplying DACs: the allowable reference-input voltage range, including the negative/four-quadrant range, V.

parameters.name: Reference input resistance (ladder)
parameters.hint: R-2R / multiplying DACs: the DC resistance looking into the reference (ladder) input, ohm. No SI prefix. Also carries a code-dependent DC input impedance where a part states one (not only the code-independent multiplying-ladder R) - keep the code in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Reference input resistance matching
parameters.hint: Channel-to-channel matching of the reference input (ladder) resistance on a multi-channel multiplying DAC, %.

parameters.name: Feedback resistance (RFB)
parameters.hint: Multiplying DACs: the on-chip feedback resistor (RFB) used with the external I-to-V op-amp, ohm - matched to the ladder so gain tracks over temperature.

parameters.name: Reference input capacitance
parameters.hint: Multiplying DACs: capacitance at the reference input, F. Code-dependent (the switched ladder presents different capacitance per code) - array over CODE.

parameters.name: Reference input impedance
parameters.hint: AC input impedance at the reference input, ohm.

parameters.name: Reference output noise
parameters.hint: Output noise of the internal reference over a stated band, statistic peak_to_peak (carry statistic on the measurement); keep the bandwidth in conditionsVerbatim. V.

parameters.name: Multiplying bandwidth
parameters.hint: Multiplying DACs: the -3 dB bandwidth of the reference-to-output (multiplying) path, Hz.

parameters.name: Reference feedthrough
parameters.hint: Multiplying DACs: reference feedthrough to the output at zero-scale code, dB, swept over reference frequency F_IN.

parameters.name: Sample / update rate
parameters.hint: Maximum conversion / update rate in Hz (1 MSPS = 1e6, 1 GSPS = 1e9). Array over MODE (interpolation / speed mode) on interpolating current_steering parts.

parameters.name: Maximum input data rate
parameters.hint: Maximum parallel / LVDS input data rate, Hz. A printed Mbps figure stays in Hz (1 Mbps = 1e6) - there is no bps unit; keep the printed Mbps figure in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: SerDes lane rate
parameters.hint: High-speed serial (JESD204B) lane bit rate, Hz. A printed Gbps figure stays in Hz (1 Gbps = 1e9) - there is no bps unit; keep the printed Gbps figure in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: DAC clock frequency
parameters.hint: The DAC sampling clock (DACCLK) input frequency, Hz. Distinct from serial_clock_frequency (the digital-interface SCLK).

parameters.name: Latency
parameters.hint: Output pipeline latency, s. Convert cycles to seconds via the clock / fS; keep the cycle count (e.g. '12 DACCLK cycles') in conditionsVerbatim. Array over MODE (interpolation mode) where the latency depends on it.

parameters.name: Power-up time
parameters.hint: Time from power-up / exit-of-power-down to a valid, settled output, s.

parameters.name: Aperture delay
parameters.hint: Delay from the sampling clock edge to the output update instant, s (current_steering parts).

parameters.name: Power-supply rejection ratio
parameters.hint: PSRR, dB. Array over F (frequency of the supply disturbance). power_supply_sensitivity is the DC %/% figure normalized to ppm/V.

parameters.name: Power-supply sensitivity
parameters.hint: DC sensitivity of the full-scale output to the supply. A printed %/% figure normalizes to ppm/V (e.g. 0.001%/% = 10 ppm/V for a nominal spec) - there is no %/% unit; keep the printed %/% in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Supply voltage
parameters.hint: Rail supply voltage, V. A DAC has several rails (analog AVDD, digital DVDD, clock CLKVDD) - array over V_SUPPLY, one measurement per rail. IO rail is io_supply_voltage.

parameters.name: IO supply voltage
parameters.hint: Digital-interface / IO rail voltage, V (OVDD / VDRIVE).

parameters.name: Supply current
parameters.hint: Operating supply current, A. Array over MODE (speed / interpolation mode); split per rail via a rail condition in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Power dissipation
parameters.hint: Total operating power, W. Array over MODE.

parameters.name: Power-down current
parameters.hint: Full power-down / shutdown / sleep current, A.

parameters.name: Serial clock frequency
parameters.hint: Maximum serial interface clock (SPI SCLK / I2C SCL), Hz.

parameters.name: Digital input high voltage
parameters.hint: Minimum logic-high input threshold on a digital control pin, V.

parameters.name: Digital input low voltage
parameters.hint: Maximum logic-low input threshold on a digital control pin, V.

parameters.name: Digital output high voltage
parameters.hint: Logic-high output voltage on a digital pin (SDO) at the specified load, V.

parameters.name: Digital output low voltage
parameters.hint: Logic-low output voltage on a digital pin at the specified load, V.

parameters.name: Operating temperature range
parameters.hint: Ambient operating temperature range, degC (min/max).

parameters.name: Junction temperature
parameters.hint: Maximum operating / absolute-max junction temperature, degC.

parameters.name: Storage temperature range
parameters.hint: Storage temperature range, degC (min/max), typically an absolute_max.

parameters.name: Thermal resistance, junction-to-ambient
parameters.hint: Junction-to-ambient thermal resistance, degC/W.

parameters.name: Thermal resistance, junction-to-case
parameters.hint: Junction-to-case thermal resistance, degC/W.

parameters.name: ESD, human-body model
parameters.hint: Human-body-model ESD withstand voltage, V.

parameters.name: ESD, charged-device model
parameters.hint: Charged-device-model ESD withstand voltage, V.

parameters.name: Long-term stability
parameters.hint: Long-term output drift / aging (precision high-res parts), ppm of full-scale (altUnits V). Keep the stated hour count (e.g. 1000 h) in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Full-scale error drift
parameters.hint: Temperature coefficient of the full-scale error, ppm/degC of full-scale (altUnits V/degC). Distinct from gain_drift and offset_error_drift.

parameters.name: Output noise (RMS)
parameters.hint: Wideband / integrated output noise, statistic rms (carry statistic on the measurement); keep the measurement bandwidth in conditionsVerbatim. V. Distinct from the 0.1-10 Hz peak-to-peak output_noise.

parameters.name: Interpolation ratio
parameters.hint: Dimensionless configurable interpolation / oversampling ratio (audio / current_steering). Capture the enumerated set with the list in conditionsVerbatim (parity with the ADC oversampling_ratio).

parameters.name: Mute attenuation
parameters.hint: Audio DAC mute / soft-mute attenuation, dB.
